scope: compiler code generation and result tagging

findings.issue: MSM API documentation claimed all points and scalars were validated before computation; native implementation validates and computes sequentially.
findings.resolution: Documentation now states packed sizes are checked before computation. Invalid inputs still return a typed error and leave ABI output unchanged.
findings.verification: source review and guarded error-output corpus

findings.detected_by: implementation runtime agent, independently verified here
findings.issue: Upstream zkcrypto 0.8.0 maps Fp2(0,0) to infinity instead of the RFC9380 image.
findings.resolution: A shared internal G2 mapping helper handles exact field zero with the independently derived pre-cofactor curve constant; both mapToG2 and hashToG2 use the helper and apply the standard cofactor clearing. Caller-supplied points continue using checked decoding.
findings.verification: py_ecc8 zero/unit/edge-map expectations plus all10 independently fetched RFC9380 hash vectors pass native, interpreter, and compiled Wasm

findings.detected_by: implementation reference audit, independently verified here
findings.issue: Initial portable reference differed from native result error precedence for malformed MSM terms and infinity keys paired with malformed signatures.
findings.resolution: Reference now follows native left-to-right point/scalar parsing and validates signature encoding before rejecting identity.
findings.verification: msm-precedence-g1/g2 and infinity-key-malformed-sig-ic/eth fixtures pass all three execution paths

findings.detected_by: implementation reference audit, independently verified here
findings.issue: A zero-length caller DST conflicts with RFC9380 section3.1.
findings.resolution: Both public hash-to-curve primitives return invalidArgument for empty DST; oversized tags normalize with SHA256.
findings.verification: empty-dst-g1/g2 and oversize-dst-g1/g2 fixtures pass all three execution paths

findings.issue: The compiler host does not export additional Zarith primitives required by the initial reference plugin.
findings.resolution: A private Num.Big_int arithmetic adapter uses the host already-linked primitives. No subprocess/native crypto bridge or host compiler changes are required.
findings.verification: actual moc -r execution of all160 primitive and24 profile assertions

findings.issue: Pippenger MSM uses scalar-dependent bucket indices and branches, unlike the original straightforward kernel. It adds a bounded decoded-input vector and fixed32-bucket stack array.
findings.resolution: Final promoted API and runtime headers explicitly document variable-time MSM for public scalars and bounded decoded-input scratch. Count is capped128 and input point/scalar errors preserve left-to-right ordering.
findings.verification: 46 independently generated py_ecc fixtures pass final native, actual moc interpreter, and compiled validated Wasm across3/4/5,15/16/17,63/64/65,127/128 with full-width scalars and identity/repeated/inverse/distinct points. Final shared build provenance matches all28 recorded plugin source entries and both artifacts.

inspection.canonical_decoding: Native G1/G2 from_compressed and portable decoder enforce compressed flags, canonical coordinates, curve membership, and prime-order subgroups; canonical infinity is accepted only by group operations.
inspection.scalars_and_fields: Big-endian scalar < r and field components < p; scalar0 valid in raw group multiplication; Fp2 map bytes real then imaginary while compressed G2 encodes imaginary x then real.
inspection.aggregate_safety: IC rejects duplicate messages. Ethereum aggregate methods verify each key proof on every call; wrong domains, mismatched proofs, and a concrete rogue-key attack are rejected. All batch lengths must match, raw cap128, general aggregate cap127.
inspection.memory_and_codegen: No retained input pointer or native cryptographic state found. All input references are borrowed only within a synchronous call. Scratch allocations use compiler-owned managed blobs without a GC safepoint. Output allocations have fixed48/96/1-byte sizes; status mapping covers codes1..10 and typed boolean/blob results. Native guard bytes and error-output immutability pass, while compiled maximum batches execute successfully.
inspection.argument_evaluation: Compiler getters read already evaluated arguments; a side-effecting public g1Add call confirms each argument is evaluated once.
inspection.msm_optimization: Reviewed 2/3/4/5-bit Pippenger windows, max32 buckets, 33-byte little-endian scalar padding, and canonical255-bit scalar bound. The highest scalar read is padded index32; digits remain within the active bucket slice. Scratch contains owned decoded points and scalars and does not retain input pointers. Raw MSM is variable-time and intended only for public scalars.

limits: Finite regression corpus and source review, not formal verification or third-party security certification.
Raw unsafe ABI assumes compiler-supplied valid pointers and advertised buffer sizes; malformed byte contents are tested, arbitrary invalid host pointers are outside that contract.
Audit does not claim exhaustive timing analysis or cover unavailable BLS signing/threshold protocols; this implementation exposes group primitives and verification profiles.
